ns2:course.label: Adm Mgt of Libs Info Centers
ns2:course.description: Designed to explore the principles that govern how organizations and institutions work, this course provides a foundation for and introduction to the theories, practices and procedures involved in the management and administration of libraries and information centers.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Lib & Inf Sci Online-UIUC.
